comparison.objective: Remove an obstruction and insert a knife safely into a holder; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Obstacle removal and deep constrained insertion versus recessed-key alignment, fine collar rotation, counterholding and cycle-based adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Knife depth/alignment and safe toy placement versus two safe carriage stops and post-lock stability.
comparison.reason: Constrained storage insertion is materially different from commissioning, with no matching adjustment or dynamic-response test. Candidate thresholds for rebound, overload and drift are missing.
